en-US.description: A modern Rust/Tauri desktop frontend for watching Twitch streams via Streamlink.
en-US.name: Stream GUI RS
en-US.releaseNotes:
Stream GUI RS 1.9.0
Changes since Stream GUI RS 1.8.0.
This feature release lets Twitch playback request HEVC and AV1 in addition to H.264.
Features
- Added Settings → Playback → Twitch codecs with Also request HEVC (H.265) and Also request AV1 (#109, #107). Both are off by default, and H.264 is always requested. Some Twitch broadcasts offer higher resolutions only with HEVC or AV1; your player and hardware must be able to decode the selected codecs. Some resolutions additionally require Twitch website sign-in, which the app still does not support. Kick and YouTube playback are unchanged. Save the setting and select Restart in Watching to apply it to a running session.
- Streamlink still runs without user configuration files (--no-config); useful Streamlink options are offered as typed settings instead.
Dependencies
- Updated Vite from 8.3.5 to 8.3.6 (#110).
- Updated jsdom from 30.1.3 to 31.0.0 and adjusted the control-height test to compare against the computed height of an element using the same CSS token (#111).
- Refreshed the npm lockfile to pick up tough-cookie 6.1.0 and undici 8.12.4 (#112).
Upgrade and platform support
Settings move from schema 11 to schema 12 when settings are next saved; existing values are unchanged and both extra codecs start off. Upgrade without signing out or clearing settings. Older versions reject the schema 12 settings file without overwriting it.
Streamlink 8.0+ and a separately installed player remain required. Package formats remain Windows x86_64 installer and portable/Scoop ZIP; Linux x86_64 AppImage, DEB and RPM; and a universal macOS DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel requiring macOS 11.0 or later. Verify downloads against the accompanying SHA-256 files.
